_source: A vocabulary translation, not a classification: each of the Congressional Research Service's policy areas (the `policyArea` Congress.gov gives every bill; the list at https://www.congress.gov/help/field-values/policy-area) mapped to the bill classifier's taxonomy categories (pipeline/analyze/bill_analyzer.POLICY_TAXONOMY) that name the same subject. An area whose bills the taxonomy splits lists every category it can be (Health: HEALTHCARE or ABORTION; Crime and Law Enforcement: JUSTICE or GUNS). An area the taxonomy has no subject for, or that mixes procedural and substantive bills (Congress: chamber rules beside ethics and stock-trading bills; Government Operations and Politics), maps to nothing and labels no bill. Read by the calibration scripts as labels (scripts/calibrate_procedural.py); nothing in classification reads it.
